Alias.name: Times of Chaos GUI controls
Alias.script: if tocMudlet and tocMudlet.command then tocMudlet.command(matches[2]) end

Script.name: tocMudlet.core
Script.script:
-- Times of Chaos official Mudlet package -- https://github.com/jeremydbean/toc2026/tree/main/mudlet tocMudlet = tocMudlet or {} if type(tocMudlet.teardown) == "function" then pcall(tocMudlet.teardown) end tocMudlet.version = "1.0.0" tocMudlet.handlers = {} tocMudlet.ui = {} tocMudlet.lastRoom = nil tocMudlet.lastExits = nil tocMudlet.enabled = true local P = { background = "#11131f", panel = "#191d2d", border = "#343a56", text = "#e7e9f2", muted = "#a5abc0", hp1 = "#7f1d1d", hp2 = "#dc2626", mana1 = "#1e3a8a", mana2 = "#3b82f6", move1 = "#14532d", move2 = "#22c55e", exp1 = "#713f12", exp2 = "#eab308", } local DIR_OFFSET = { n = { 0, 1, 0}, e = { 1, 0, 0}, s = { 0, -1, 0}, w = {-1, 0, 0}, u = { 0, 0, 1}, d = { 0, 0, -1}, ne = { 1, 1, 0}, nw = {-1, 1, 0}, se = { 1, -1, 0}, sw = {-1, -1, 0}, } local ENVIRONMENT = { inside = 201, city = 202, field = 203, forest = 204, hills = 205, mountains = 206, water = 207, ["deep-water"] = 208, underwater = 209, air = 210, desert = 211, underground = 212, } local function html(text) text = tostring(text or "") return text:gsub("&", "&"):gsub("<", "<"):gsub(">", ">") end local function number(value, fallback) local parsed = tonumber(value) if parsed == nil then return fallback or 0 end return parsed end local function roomExistsSafe(roomId) if not roomExists then return false end local ok, exists = pcall(roomExists, roomId) return ok and exists and true or false end local function setupEnvironmentColours() if not setCustomEnvColor then return end local colours = { [201] = {75, 78, 95}, [202] = {145, 150, 165}, [203] = {104, 159, 92}, [204] = {38, 113, 68}, [205] = {126, 145, 74}, [206] = {113, 105, 101}, [207] = {48, 145, 196}, [208] = {28, 90, 151}, [209] = {24, 73, 110}, [210] = {125, 211, 252}, [211] = {202, 151, 71}, [212] = {90, 75, 62}, } for environment, rgb in pairs(colours) do pcall(setCustomEnvColor, environment, rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3]) end end local function ensureArea(name) name = tostring(name or "Unknown Area") if getAreaTable then local ok, areas = pcall(getAreaTable) if ok and type(areas) == "table" and tonumber(areas[name]) then return tonumber(areas[name]) end end if addAreaName then local ok, areaId = pcall(addAreaName, name) if ok and tonumber(areaId) and tonumber(areaId) > 0 then return tonumber(areaId) end end return -1 end local function directionTo(roomInfo, target) if type(roomInfo) ~= "table" or type(roomInfo.exits) ~= "table" then return nil end for direction, destination in pairs(roomInfo.exits) do if tonumber(destination) == tonumber(target) and DIR_OFFSET[direction] then return direction end end return nil end local function placeNearPrevious(roomId, areaId) local x, y, z = 0, 0, 0 local direction = directionTo(tocMudlet.lastExits, roomId) if direction and tocMudlet.lastRoom and getRoomCoordinates and roomExistsSafe(tocMudlet.lastRoom) then local ok, px, py, pz = pcall(getRoomCoordinates, tocMudlet.lastRoom) if ok and px ~= nil then local offset = DIR_OFFSET[direction] x, y, z = number(px) + offset[1], number(py) + offset[2], number(pz) + offset[3] end end if setRoomCoordinates then pcall(setRoomCoordinates, roomId, x, y, z) end if areaId > 0 and setRoomArea then pcall(setRoomArea, roomId, areaId) end end local function ensureRoom(roomId, info) local created = false local areaId = ensureArea(info.area) if not roomExistsSafe(roomId) and addRoom then local ok, result = pcall(addRoom, roomId) created = ok and result ~= false end if not roomExistsSafe(roomId) then return false end if created then placeNearPrevious(roomId, areaId) end if areaId > 0 and setRoomArea then pcall(setRoomArea, roomId, areaId) end if setRoomName then pcall(setRoomName, roomId, tostring(info.name or roomId)) end if setRoomEnv then pcall(setRoomEnv, roomId, ENVIRONMENT[tostring(info.environment)] or 201) end return true end local function linkKnownExits(roomId, exits) if type(exits) ~= "table" or not setExit then return end for direction, target in pairs(exits) do local targetId = tonumber(target) if targetId and DIR_OFFSET[direction] then if roomExistsSafe(targetId) then pcall(setExit, roomId, targetId, direction) if setExitStub then pcall(setExitStub, roomId, direction, false) end elseif setExitStub then pcall(setExitStub, roomId, direction, true) end end end end function tocMudlet.onRoomInfo() local info = gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info if type(info) ~= "table" then return end local roomId = tonumber(info.num or info.id) if not roomId then return end if ensureRoom(roomId, info) then linkKnownExits(roomId, info.exits) if tocMudlet.lastRoom and roomExistsSafe(tocMudlet.lastRoom) then linkKnownExits(tocMudlet.lastRoom, type(tocMudlet.lastExits) == "table" and tocMudlet.lastExits.exits or nil) end if centerview then pcall(centerview, roomId) end end tocMudlet.lastRoom = roomId tocMudlet.lastExits = info if tocMudlet.ui.location then tocMudlet.ui.location:echo(string.format( [[%s %s · #%d]], P.text, html(info.name or "Unknown room"), P.muted, html(info.area or "Unknown Area"), roomId)) end end local function setGauge(gauge, current, maximum, label) if not gauge then return end current, maximum = number(current), math.max(1, number(maximum, 1)) gauge:setValue(current, maximum, string.format("%s %d / %d", label, current, maximum)) end function tocMudlet.onVitals() local vitals = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals if type(vitals) ~= "table" then return end setGauge(tocMudlet.ui.hp, vitals.hp or vitals.health, vitals.maxhp or vitals.maxhealth, "HP") setGauge(tocMudlet.ui.mana, vitals.mana, vitals.maxmana, "MANA") setGauge(tocMudlet.ui.move, vitals.moves or vitals.move, vitals.maxmoves or vitals.maxmove, "MOVE") local exp, maxexp = number(vitals.exp), number(vitals.maxexp, 1) local toLevel = number(vitals.tnl) if tocMudlet.ui.exp then tocMudlet.ui.exp:setValue(exp, math.max(1, maxexp), string.format("EXP %d to level", toLevel)) end end function tocMudlet.onStatus() local status = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Status if type(status) ~= "table" or not tocMudlet.ui.identity then return end tocMudlet.ui.identity:echo(string.format( [[
%s
]] .. [[
Level %s %s · %s
]], P.text, html(status.name or "Times of Chaos"), P.muted, html(status.level or "?"), html(status.race or ""), html(status.class or ""))) end local function styleGauge(gauge, first, second) gauge.front:setStyleSheet(string.format([[ background: qlineargradient(x1:0,y1:0,x2:1,y2:0,stop:0 %s,stop:1 %s); border: 1px solid #090a10; border-radius: 4px;]], first, second)) gauge.back:setStyleSheet(string.format([[ background: %s; border: 1px solid %s; border-radius: 4px;]], P.background, P.border)) gauge.text:setStyleSheet(string.format([[ color: %s; font-family: "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: 600; qproperty-alignment: 'AlignCenter';]], P.text)) end function tocMudlet.buildUI() setBorderTop(58) setBorderRight(360) setBorderBottom(34) tocMudlet.ui.topBackground = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "tocMudlet.topBackground", x = 0, y = 0, width = "100%-360px", height = 58, }) tocMudlet.ui.topBackground:setStyleSheet(string.format( "background:%s;border-bottom:1px solid %s;", P.panel, P.border)) tocMudlet.ui.gauges = Geyser.HBox:new({ name = "tocMudlet.gauges", x = 8, y = 8, width = "100%-376px", height = 42, }) tocMudlet.ui.hp = Geyser.Gauge:new({name = "tocMudlet.hp"}, tocMudlet.ui.gauges) tocMudlet.ui.mana = Geyser.Gauge:new({name = "tocMudlet.mana"}, tocMudlet.ui.gauges) tocMudlet.ui.move = Geyser.Gauge:new({name = "tocMudlet.move"}, tocMudlet.ui.gauges) tocMudlet.ui.exp = Geyser.Gauge:new({name = "tocMudlet.exp"}, tocMudlet.ui.gauges) styleGauge(tocMudlet.ui.hp, P.hp1, P.hp2) styleGauge(tocMudlet.ui.mana, P.mana1, P.mana2) styleGauge(tocMudlet.ui.move, P.move1, P.move2) styleGauge(tocMudlet.ui.exp, P.exp1, P.exp2) setGauge(tocMudlet.ui.hp, 0, 1, "HP") setGauge(tocMudlet.ui.mana, 0, 1, "MANA") setGauge(tocMudlet.ui.move, 0, 1, "MOVE") tocMudlet.ui.exp:setValue(0, 1, "EXP") tocMudlet.ui.rightBackground = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "tocMudlet.rightBackground", x = -360, y = 0, width = 360, height = "100%", }) tocMudlet.ui.rightBackground:setStyleSheet(string.format( "background:%s;border-left:1px solid %s;", P.panel, P.border)) tocMudlet.ui.identity = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "tocMudlet.identity", x = -350, y = 8, width = 340, height = 48, }) tocMudlet.ui.identity:setStyleSheet(string.format([[ background:%s;color:%s;border:1px solid %s;border-radius:5px; padding:4px 8px;qproperty-alignment:'AlignVCenter';]], P.background, P.text, P.border)) tocMudlet.ui.identity:echo("Times of Chaos
Connecting...") tocMudlet.ui.mapper = Geyser.Mapper:new({ name = "tocMudlet.mapper", x = -350, y = 64, width = 340, height = "100%-112px", }) tocMudlet.ui.mapHint = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "tocMudlet.mapHint", x = -350, y = -42, width = 340, height = 32, }) tocMudlet.ui.mapHint:setStyleSheet(string.format([[ background:%s;color:%s;border:1px solid %s;border-radius:5px; qproperty-alignment:'AlignCenter';]], P.background, P.muted, P.border)) tocMudlet.ui.mapHint:echo("GMCP mapper · tocgui off hides this interface") tocMudlet.ui.location = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "tocMudlet.location", x = 0, y = -34, width = "100%-360px", height = 34, }) tocMudlet.ui.location:setStyleSheet(string.format([[ background:%s;color:%s;border-top:1px solid %s;padding:6px 12px; qproperty-alignment:'AlignVCenter';]], P.panel, P.text, P.border)) tocMudlet.ui.location:echo("Waiting for room information...") end function tocMudlet.teardownUI() for _, widget in pairs(tocMudlet.ui or {}) do if type(widget) == "table" and widget.hide then pcall(function() widget:hide() end) end if type(widget) == "table" and widget.delete then pcall(function() widget:delete() end) end end tocMudlet.ui = {} if setBorderSizes then pcall(setBorderSizes, 0, 0, 0, 0) end end function tocMudlet.subscribe() if not sendGMCP then return end sendGMCP('Core.Hello {"client":"Mudlet","version":"TimesOfChaos ' .. tocMudlet.version .. '"}') sendGMCP('Core.Supports.Add ["Char 1","Char.Vitals 1","Char.Status 1",' .. '"Room 1","Room.Info 1"]') end function tocMudlet.refresh() if gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals then tocMudlet.onVitals() end if gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Status then tocMudlet.onStatus() end if gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info then tocMudlet.onRoomInfo() end end function tocMudlet.command(action) action = action or "status" if action == "off" then tocMudlet.enabled = false tocMudlet.teardownUI() cecho("\nTimes of Chaos GUI hidden. Type tocgui on to restore it.\n") elseif action == "on" then if not tocMudlet.enabled or not tocMudlet.ui.mapper then tocMudlet.enabled = true tocMudlet.buildUI() tocMudlet.refresh() end cecho("\nTimes of Chaos GUI enabled.\n") else cecho(string.format("\nTimes of Chaos Mudlet package %s: GUI %s, GMCP %s.\n", tocMudlet.version, tocMudlet.enabled and "on" or "off", (gmcp and gmcp.Char) and "active" or "waiting")) end end local function register(event, callback) if registerAnonymousEventHandler then local id = registerAnonymousEventHandler(event, callback) table.insert(tocMudlet.handlers, id) end end function tocMudlet.install() setupEnvironmentColours() tocMudlet.buildUI() register("gmcp.Char.Vitals", function() tocMudlet.onVitals() end) register("gmcp.Char.Status", function() tocMudlet.onStatus() end) register("gmcp.Room.Info", function() tocMudlet.onRoomInfo() end) register("sysConnectionEvent", function() tocMudlet.subscribe() end) register("sysUninstallPackage", function(_, packageName) if packageName == "TimesOfChaos" then tocMudlet.teardown() end end) if isConnected and isConnected() then tocMudlet.subscribe() end tempTimer(0.1, tocMudlet.refresh) cecho("\nTimes of Chaos Mudlet interface ready. " .. "Type tocgui for status or tocgui off to hide it.\n") end function tocMudlet.teardown() for _, handler in ipairs(tocMudlet.handlers or {}) do if killAnonymousEventHandler then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, handler) end end tocMudlet.handlers = {} tocMudlet.teardownUI() end tocMudlet.install()
